defs.def: extremely important, because it will affect other things 至关重要的；关键性的adv.

ex.s: Beyond visitor interaction, AI plays a crucial role in preserving priceless artworks.
ex.t: 除了访客互动，人工智能在保护无价艺术品方面也发挥着关键作用。

ex.s: In this book I examine three crucial stages in the history of mean sea level.
ex.t: 在本书中，我考察了平均海平面历史上的三个关键阶段。

ex.s: Carbon removal is crucial for fighting climate change.
ex.t: 碳移除对于应对气候变化至关重要。

ex.s: There’s a crucial difference between failing at the right thing and persisting at the wrong one.
ex.t: 在正确的事上失败，与在错误的事上坚持，二者有着关键的区别。

ex.s: It is crucial to improve the definition of time．
ex.t: 改进时间的定义至关重要．

ex.s: One thing crucial to the increasing number of “urban animals” is their ability to adapt.
ex.t: 对日益增多的城市动物来说，关键的一点是它们的适应能力。

ex.s: Every day Mei watched them as they flew, which helped him to develop the expressive eye movements that were so crucial to his art.
ex.t: 梅兰芳每天都看着它们飞翔，这帮助他发展出了对他的艺术至关重要的富有表现力的眼神动作。

ex.s: She made a crucial but potentially difficult-to-understand subject interesting and accessible to millions of people.
ex.t: 她将一个关键但可能难以理解的学科变得有趣，让数百万人能够理解。

ex.s: The crucial thing is using body language in a way that is appropriate to the culture you are in.
ex.t: 关键是要以适合你所在文化的方式使用肢体语言。

ex.s: REFLECTING crucial perceive lack component demonstrate interact stare at embarrassment UNIT 4 BODY LANGUAGE UNIT 4 BODY LANGUAGE 1 In groups, brainstorm a list of different kinds of body language.
ex.t: 反思：关键的、感知、缺乏、组成部分、展示、互动、凝视、尴尬　单元4 肢体语言　1 分组头脑风暴，列出不同类型的肢体语言。
